model: Lowara hydrovar X HVX / HVX+ pump drive (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Xylem Lowara hydrovar X HVX and HVX+ motor-mounted pump drives with firmware 01.00.00, single or multi-pump.
summary: The hydrovar X HVX / HVX+ drive mounts on the pump motor and has BACnet MS/TP built in. Analog Inputs give the last ten errors with their logged operating data, actual pressure, flow, temperature and level, speed, current, power, voltages, temperatures, I/O status and firmware versions; Analog Values carry start/stop, error reset and the full drive parameter set (control mode, setpoints, ramps, limits, sensor scaling, multipump and communication settings). Three CharacterString values hold part and serial numbers.
notes: The tables have no read/write column; Analog Values (parameters and commands) are taken as writable and Analog Inputs as read-only.
Many units follow unit-selection parameters (P04.0.11 pressure, P04.0.12 flow, P04.0.13 temperature, P04.0.14 level, P04.0.15 power, P04.0.16 energy); the description names the parameter.
Objects marked "HVX+ only" (menu index flagged [X+]) exist only on the HVX+.
The manual prints AI 73-90 twice around the page 75/76 break (the repeat names AI 77 "Log: Motor load"); each is listed once. AV 41-44, 64, 88-89 and 126-127 are not in the table.
Error log objects (AI 0-199) repeat in blocks of 20 for errors 1-10; names carry the error number.
Set P04.1.60 Limit Setpoint Saving to Yes when setpoints are written often, to spare the EEPROM.

source.title: HVX, HVX+ Installation, Operation and Programming Manual, ch. 7.4-7.6 BACnet objects

integration.summary: Start and stop the pump with AV 0 and reset errors with AV 1. Choose the control mode (AV 3) and write the active setpoint; read pump status (AI 211), actual pressure (AI 205), motor speed (AI 215/216), power and the most recent error (AI 0).
integration.enable: AV 0 SET_STARTSTOP starts (1) and stops (0) the pump.
setup: Factory device instance 84003 (P08.2.04 or Object_Identifier); MAC address 1 (P08.2.01); MS/TP settings are AV 142-148.
gotchas: Set P04.1.60 Limit Setpoint Saving (AV 163) to Yes before writing setpoints cyclically, to spare the EEPROM.
Bitfield objects (error, alarm, status) must be split into bits; the meanings are in the manual.
